description: This Java source file defines a class MyReceiver that implements the Android OnReceiveContentListener interface. It handles incoming content, especially URIs with images, by storing images and showing information for other types. It manages permissions and utilizes background execution for processing content and updating the UI.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: A final class implementing OnReceiveContentListener that handles incoming content by processing URIs, particularly images, and displaying information for other content types.

methods.name: MyReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes attachments repository and RecyclerView adapter.

methods.name: onReceiveContent
methods.description: Handles incoming ContentInfo by partitioning it into URI content and remaining content, processing URIs, and returning unhandled content.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Processes the ContentInfo payload, storing images locally and displaying info for other types, using background threads and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Reads URI content length and shows a toast with its type and size, executing IO in background and UI updates on main thread.
